source.text: 它大於容量八，這次正確回傳拒絕。

source.text: 但只看這兩筆，怎麼確認中間沒有別的錯？

context.english: But how do two cases rule out errors in between?

First chose and all preserve temporal and quantifier scope; each 0..4 digit remains. Smallness is visible from exact values and need not be separately pronounced. No unrelated five-row layout change or extra input is introduced.
